text:
Alex Johnson: Hey @Priya — Skyline wants a 6-week POC and is asking for 40% off hosted API list + one dedicated GPU node free for the POC. Can we approve?
Priya Nair: 40% is pretty big. What’s the expected ARR if they convert?
Alex Johnson: Sales deck shows ~$120k ARR yr1 if they convert. POC usage roughly 200k units/mo.
Jordan Lee: For POCs we usually cap discounts at ~25% plus credits, or require conversion commitment for larger. Any signed LOI?
Alex Johnson: Not yet—customer said they’d sign an LOI committing to 12 months post-POC but asked for pricing first.
Mei Chen: From infra: free dedicated node for 6 weeks is possible but needs a setup fee, an IP allowlist, and 48h lead time to provision. Also need to reserve capacity.
Carlos Reyes: Quick math: at list pricing that POC usage = ~$6k/mo. 40% off + free node plus setup cost eats margin. Need a break-even calc.
Jordan Lee: Can you paste the usage and list rates into the pricing request sheet? We need ARR, gross margin impact, and expected conversion probability.
Alex Johnson: Done — numbers added to the sheet: https://go.redwood/pricing/req/1815
Dwight (Deal Desk): Thx. Two quick options that can be approved at different levels: (A) Director-approve: 30% off hosted usage + $10k POC credit (no free dedicated but discounted reserved node rate) OR (B) VP-approve: up to 40% + free node for 6 weeks if we get a signed LOI before provisioning.
Priya Nair: Also note: any POC with dedicated infra requires NDA + clear data handling controls. No custom SLA for POC — standard trial terms only.
Alex Johnson: Customer wants a delivery demo next Mon. Is there any way to fast-track the LOI so we can provision?
Mei Chen: We can provision a sandbox node sooner if legal provides an NDA and security signs off on the IP allowlist. Ops needs 48h after that.
Jordan Lee: I'll assemble the P&L impact and recommended discount band. Alex, please confirm probability of conversion (high/med/low) in the sheet.
Alex Johnson: Marked conversion probability as 'medium' and added notes about executive sponsorship.
Carlos Reyes: :thumbsup: I recommend Director approval for 30% + $10k credit, require LOI to escalate to VP for 40%.
Dwight (Deal Desk): On it — I'll review and try to get director sign-off by EOD. If you secure LOI + NDA, ping me and I’ll escalate to VP. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya Nair: One more ask — include the requested commit term post-POC in the LOI (we usually ask 12mo min to justify the discount).
Alex Johnson: Will do. Mei, coordinating NDA/allowlist now.
Mei Chen: Copy. Blocking provision window Tue-Wed in case we get approvals.
Dwight (Deal Desk): Update: Director approved 30% + $10k credit conditional on LOI + NDA. Will repost final approval language once legal confirms.
Alex Johnson: Excellent — thanks everyone. I’ll push LOI and ping when signed.
